visuals_tables.layout_logic: Intro uses KPI gap table and early figures; vision and requirements sections include multiple tables/figures to anchor pillars and scenarios; technology and testbed sections sprinkle figures to illustrate architectures and platforms.

lesson_blocks.lesson: Use KPI gap tables and evolution figures to justify a forward-looking survey.
Break vision into pillars and pair KPI tables with scenarios to keep requirements grounded.
Present architecture evolution then list technology buckets with consistent micro-structure.
Group testbeds into channel, key-tech, and comprehensive platforms to show validation depth.
Cluster future work into theory, challenges, and system research before a short lessons-learned wrap.

synthesis.aha_moment: The survey advances from 5G gaps to vision and KPIs, then architectures and technologies, and finally validation platforms—creating a structured runway from motivation to practical readiness and future challenges.

methodology.selection_criteria: Curated 6G white papers, surveys, and emerging research; no explicit database filters stated.

style.section_openers_pattern: Opens with a brief scope statement then enumerates upcoming subsections.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: KPI gap hook with early table
steps: Open with current-generation limitations and a KPI gap table.
Tie the gaps to the need for the next generation.
Follow immediately with contribution bullets and roadmap.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Quantified gaps plus a roadmap quickly establish urgency and credibility.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Vision pillars with micro-structure
steps: Define 4–6 vision pillars with one-sentence rationale each.
Provide a short example or implication per pillar.
Close with a summary paragraph to restitch the pillars.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Repeating micro-structure keeps a broad vision scannable and coherent.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: KPI table + scenario pairing
steps: List KPIs with target numbers in a table.
Map each KPI to example scenarios in text.
Add a short trade-off paragraph to connect the KPIs.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Tables give numeric clarity; mapping and trade-offs keep them grounded in applications.
evidence_locators: III. 6G TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS AND APPLICATION SCENARIOS L309-L435

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Technology bucket parade
steps: Define technology buckets (e.g., spectrum, air interface, physical dimensions, capabilities).
For each, give a 2–3 sentence rationale and KPI linkage.
Point to figures/tables for visual anchors.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: A fixed bucket template prevents reader fatigue across a long technology list.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Validation ladder
steps: Present testbeds in ascending scope: channel → key technology → comprehensive platforms.
Note what each validates and limitations.
End with a bridge to future research challenges.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Shows progression from theory to practice and readies the reader for the challenge section.
